nodes.label: Build & Initialization Failure
nodes.definition: Failures during installation, build, compilation, or backend/runtime initialization.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a termination after runtime began.

nodes.label: Crash
nodes.definition: Functionality is terminated unexpectedly, usually with errors or exceptions.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a pre-runtime build or initialization failure.
Operational boundary: exclude incorrect output when execution continues.

nodes.label: Document Error
nodes.definition: Faults in official documents, tutorials, examples, links, or instructions.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude runtime behavior when the documented object is not faulty.

nodes.label: Incorrect Functionality
nodes.definition: The system runs without crashing but produces incorrect, inconsistent, null, NaN, or inaccurate results.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude unexpected process termination.
Operational boundary: exclude a primarily slow, hanging, leaking, or resource-abnormal outcome.

nodes.label: Poor Performance
nodes.definition: The system runs but is slow, hangs, leaks memory, or consumes abnormal resources.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a primarily incorrect result when time and resource behavior is not the issue.

nodes.label: API Misuse
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by misunderstanding or incorrectly using an API.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a configuration defect when API use itself is not incorrect.

nodes.label: Browser Incompatibility
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by browser-specific behavior or browser support limitations.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a hardware or operating-system limitation without browser-specific evidence.
Operational boundary: exclude an inherent WebGL limitation when browser support is not the direct cause.

nodes.label: Confused Document
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by unclear, wrong, or misleading documentation.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a correct document when the defect is in implementation or configuration.

nodes.label: Cross-platform App Framework Incompatibility
nodes.definition: The issue involves incompatibility with frameworks such as React Native or other cross-platform app environments.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a generic device limitation without a cross-platform framework interaction.

nodes.label: Data/Model Inaccessibility
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by inaccessible model/data files, path problems, CORS, fetch failures, or loading failures.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a configuration defect when the direct mechanism is inaccessible data or model content.

nodes.label: Dependency Error
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by missing, redundant, conflicting, vulnerable, or incompatible dependencies.
nearest_neighbors: Incompatibilitty between 3rd-party DL Library and TF.js
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a source import defect when the dependency set itself is not the cause.
Operational boundary: exclude a third-party DL library and TF.js incompatibility when a generic dependency relationship is direct.
Operational boundary: exclude inconsistent module behavior without a dependency relationship.
Operational boundary: exclude version lag when incompatibility is not due to delayed updating.

nodes.label: Device Incompatibility
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by specific hardware, OS, or device support limitations.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude browser-specific behavior without a device support limitation.

nodes.label: Import Error
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by missing, wrong, duplicate, or conflicting imports.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a package dependency defect when imports are correct.

nodes.label: Improper Exception Handling
nodes.definition: The issue involves missing, suspicious, unclear, or misleading exception handling.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a generic implementation defect when exception handling is not implicated.

nodes.label: Improper Model Attribute
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by inappropriate model/tensor attributes, model size, model parameters, or tensor/model properties.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude generic implementation logic when no model or tensor attribute is directly improper.

nodes.label: Incompatibilitty between 3rd-party DL Library and TF.js
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by incompatibility between a third-party deep learning library and TensorFlow.js. Use this exact label string, including its spelling.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a generic dependency defect without a third-party DL library and TF.js incompatibility.

nodes.label: Inconsistent Modules
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by inconsistent behavior or implementation across TensorFlow.js modules.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a dependency-set defect when module inconsistency is not direct.
Operational boundary: exclude local code logic when the relevant defect spans module behavior.

nodes.label: Incorrect Code Logic
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by faulty implementation logic, algorithm logic, memory management, or environment adaptation.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude an exception-handling defect when that behavior is direct.
Operational boundary: exclude a model or tensor attribute defect when that property is direct.
Operational boundary: exclude cross-module inconsistency when local logic is not the direct mechanism.

nodes.label: Misconfiguration
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by incorrect environment, build, bundler, backend, or runtime configuration.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude incorrect API use when configuration is correct.
Operational boundary: exclude inaccessible data or model content when configuration is not direct.

nodes.label: Unimplemented Operator
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by an operator or function not yet supported or implemented.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a WebGL limitation when the operator is implemented but the platform cannot support it.

nodes.label: Unknown
nodes.definition: The root cause cannot be determined from the available issue evidence.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude when direct evidence supports a more specific official root-cause label.

nodes.label: Untimely Update
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by outdated packages, delayed updates, or version lag.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude a dependency error when the package or version is not stale or delayed.

nodes.label: WebGL Limits
nodes.definition: The issue is caused by inherent WebGL limitations.
exclusion_rules: Operational boundary: exclude browser-specific support behavior when there is no inherent WebGL limit.
Operational boundary: exclude an unsupported operator when the platform limit is not the mechanism.
